description: Start here. Verify a Korean corporation by name, business registration number (10 digits), corporate registration number (13 digits), DART code (8 digits) or stock code (6 digits): does it exist, its National Tax Service status (active / suspended / closed, with the date it was checked), official numbers, Korean and English names, address, industry and sources. Up to 10 matches, best-known company first; more_matches=true means add the business number or city to narrow. Each match has match_type. Corporations only — individual businesses are answered as not supported. No scores or judgements. No key needed. (한국 법인 확인)
